title: Delacroix (French Foreign Minister) → Létombe (French consul general, Philadelphia), despatch No. 5 entirely in a French numeric code, copy sent by Rufus King
correspondents: Charles Delacroix → Philippe de Létombe (copy forwarded by Rufus King to Timothy Pickering)
date: 25 Messidor an V (13 July 1797); enclosed in King No. 53, London, 12 Nov 1797
shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Great Britain, vol. 5 (10 Aug 1796-28 Dec 1797) = microfilm M30 roll 4 (image path M30-004), catalog naId 188512917
folio_note: frames 0244 right, 0245 left and right (0244 left blank): 653 code groups, values 2-1198, 297 distinct, in a clerk's copy marked 'Dup.', '(Copy)', 'No. 5 Duplicata'; heading and close in clear, signed 'Ch. Delacroix'; catchwords (806, 278) at the page feet confirm no group lost between pages. King's covering No. 53 ends on frame 0243.
status: Transcribed in full by Michael Brackx (issue #122, 27 Oct 2026; transcription in the issue). King's No. 53: 'I have no means of decyphering it'; no decipherment on frames 0236-0252. Turner, Correspondence of the French Ministers 1791-1797 (AHA 1903) does not print No. 5, but prints Létombe's reply No. 42 (22 Brumaire an VI, p. 1077, from the ministry's decipherment, CP États-Unis 48 f. 355): he will follow what the 25 Messidor despatch prescribed for keeping his political correspondence, 'dont je dicte moi-même les chiffres'. So part of No. 5 is probably about the keeping and ciphering of his political letters. Statistics: repeats 705 806 711/400 405 ×7, 474 670 1068 ×3; adjacent frequent pairs 972/973 and 81/82 hint at a one-part code, but a one-part word anneal did not converge; flat profile (top ten 14%). Not on DECODE.
why: A Directory instruction to the French chargé/consul general in Philadelphia days before Delacroix left office and on the eve of the XYZ mission, which Rufus King obtained in London (probably from Grenville's decipherers); its content is not known from the US side.
prior_art: open (27 Oct 2026). Turner 1903 checked by Michael Brackx: No. 5 not printed; reply No. 42 printed p. 1077.
